about: This page is React (src/pages/playback/PlaybackPage.jsx). The engine that plays the cut is src/pages/playback/player.js: the legacy chunk moved verbatim (same names, same bodies), so the backend checks that read or execute pb* functions keep testing the code that runs. The page puts every engine function on window at mount, because the engine renders HTML with inline handlers that call them by name. tools/split-map.js stops generating it and drops the legacy code below.
